what: The verified record behind NFL Career Path (src/data/nflCareerPlayers.ts), Round 922. One entry per shipped row, same order. Every fact carries the sources that showed it, on at least two different hosts, with the value each one showed and the date it was read. scripts/simNflCareerPathFacts.mjs pins the shipped file to this record and to scripts/data/nflRosters2026.json.
method: Read 2026-10-03 with curl from nfl.com player and career stats pages (league), ESPN athlete and stats endpoints, profootballarchives.com player pages (era team names and jersey numbers by season), the Pro Football Hall of Fame player pages, and the nflverse releases on github.com (season rosters with jersey numbers, the players table, and the draft_picks table built from Pro Football Reference). pro-football-reference.com itself refused the requests (HTTP 403). Teams are listed in the order played, a return to a club is listed again, and a club is named as it was called in those seasons (Washington before 2022 stays plain Washington, the existing convention). A jersey number ships only when two hosts show it; numbers seen on one host only are listed under heldOut. Career Stat lines that rested on a single source (Super Bowl counts, records, nicknames) were replaced by a number two hosts agree on; the replaced text is kept under was.
